title: Berkson's paradox
content: Two otherwise unrelated diseases both cause hospitalization. Restricting a study to hospitalized patients conditions on their common effect and induces a spurious association between the diseases.

variables.name: Disease 1
variables.content: The first disease in Berkson's hospital-selection example.

variables.name: Disease 2
variables.content: The second disease, independent of Disease 1 in the general population.
